answer: The atlas test I would run is Proof of unique weather balloon launch log: launches logged with recovery reports over seasons, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so launches logged with recovery reports over seasons stays private; the haven is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the shale of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
